case.question: Describe the default factory reset procedure for the GS10 drive and what parameter controls this.

key_points: Default parameters are reset by setting P053 (Reset Defaults) to value '2' 'Factory Reset'
After factory reset, all user parameters return to original defaults from the factory
The drive must be power-cycled to apply the factory reset completely
GS10 keypad will require re-entry of basic parameters after factory reset (Speed Reference, Control Source, etc.)
wrong_if: States that holding the Esc key for 10 seconds performs a factory reset
Claims factory reset clears stored fault history but retains custom parameter values
Recommends factory reset as the first troubleshooting step before checking control wiring
Confuses parameter P053 with P051 or P052 (which are backfill or recovery functions)

turns.question: Describe the default factory reset procedure for the GS10 drive and what parameter controls this.
turns.answer: P00.02 is the parameter that controls the factory reset of the GS10 drive; setting it to the desired reset code (e.g., 9 for a 50 Hz default reset or 10 for a 60 Hz default reset) and writing the value initiates the reset [1]. With the drive isolated, locked out and the DC bus verified at 0 V, change P00.02 to the appropriate reset value and confirm the write to restore the drive to its factory defaults.
